name: Pronounce English
headline:
A little practice.
A clearer voice.
subhead: Listen to useful English phrases, record yourself and get AI pronunciation feedback. Practice at your own pace.

workflow.title: Choose a phrase
workflow.body: Pick a unit for an everyday situation, from introductions to ordering food.

workflow.title: Listen, then record
workflow.body: Hear the reference audio and record yourself saying the phrase.

workflow.title: Review and repeat
workflow.body: Use the pronunciation score as feedback and keep track of your practice.

insightBody: Reference audio gives you something to listen to; recording gives you a way to try it yourself. Revisit phrases as often as you need.
note: Start with Unit 1 for free. Pronounce Pro unlocks all 10 units through a monthly or annual subscription.
purchase: Free to download · In-app purchases available
